proposals.proposal: Add exactly scripts/build-lock.mjs to CHK-006 files.modify. Add a bounded, per-build-target, in-process FIFO admission layer around withBuildLock so same-process calls enter in invocation order. Each admitted call must still acquire and release the existing proper-lockfile mutex with unchanged stale, heartbeat, retry, cross-process exclusion, and crash-recovery semantics. Queue state must be removed after the last waiter and released in finally on callback or lock failure. Add regression coverage through already-scoped CHK-006 test surfaces for FIFO order, mutual exclusion, failure-not-poisoning, target independence, queue cleanup, and retained proper-lockfile behavior. Modifying the immutable RED or rerunning until scheduling happens to pass is forbidden.
proposals.reason: The immutable RED invokes two withBuildLock calls synchronously and requires first-enter, first-exit, second-enter, second-exit. Current withBuildLock reaches await lockfile.lock independently in both calls; proper-lockfile supplies a correct cross-process crash-safe mutex but no invocation-order fairness, so either promise may acquire first. The observed second-before-first result is therefore a genuine nondeterministic contract failure. A per-target FIFO admission layer is the minimal architecture-preserving fix because it orders only same-process admission while retaining proper-lockfile as the cross-process authority.

decision.rationale: Independent rerun and INIT review prove a genuine same-process FIFO determinism gap. Accept exactly scripts/build-lock.mjs, preserving every existing proper-lockfile cross-process and crash-safety invariant with explicit cleanup/failure/target-isolation regressions.
